name: GhostChat – Live Chat, AI Chatbot & Customer Support
author: Jacob Orbach

sections.description:
GhostChat is live chat and an AI chatbot for WordPress, built for people who do not want another app to check. Answer visitors straight from Gmail — reply to the email, the visitor sees it in the chat widget. The mobile dashboard and the web dashboard are there when you want them.

Why GhostChat?

  • Answer from Gmail – A new chat arrives as an email. Reply to it and the visitor gets your message in the widget. No new inbox to learn.
  • No cookie banner – Zero cookies and zero tracking, so the widget adds nothing to your consent requirements
  • AI chatbot (Claude) — included in every plan, even Free – Answers visitor questions 24/7 from a knowledge base it can draft by reading your site, then hands off to you when it cannot
  • Will not slow your site down – The widget is ~15KB — up to 58x smaller than Intercom, Tidio, Tawk.to or Crisp (measured August 2026) — and it does not move your Lighthouse or Core Web Vitals scores
  • Real-time messaging – 15-30ms edge-powered delivery worldwide
  • Reply from your phone – The dashboard is a mobile PWA. Install it and answer chats like WhatsApp.
  • WooCommerce auto-integration – Real-time cart & page context, zero configuration (Pro and up)
  • Team inbox – Invite teammates to a shared inbox (2 seats on Pro, up to 10 on Team)
  • CRM Lite – Built-in contacts, conversation history, and notes
  • Auto-translate – 133+ languages, real-time visitor message translation (Pro and up)
  • Canned responses – Save time with pre-written replies
  • Webhooks & Bot Agent API – Integrate with your stack, or bring your own LLM (all paid plans)

How it works:

  1. Sign up free at GhostChat
  2. Create a site and get your Site ID
  3. Enter your Site ID in the plugin settings
  4. The chat widget appears on your site automatically

Pricing:

The AI assistant is included in every plan — there is no AI add-on to buy. Flat monthly prices, no per-seat fees; current pricing is always at ghostchat.dev/pricing.

  • Free (forever): 1 site, 1 seat, 30-day history, AI assistant included (10 AI replies/mo, 10-entry knowledge base), no credit card required
  • Pro: 2 seats, 3 sites, 1-year history, bigger AI allowance (400 replies/mo, 25-entry knowledge base), business hours, visitor context & page journey, WooCommerce cart context, CSV export, auto-translate (133+ languages), webhooks, Bot Agent API (bring your own LLM)
  • Team: Everything in Pro plus up to 10 team members, 10 sites, unlimited history, biggest AI allowance (800 replies/mo, 50-entry knowledge base), remove GhostChat branding, custom visitor context, identity verification, and priority support

Perfect for:

  • Small businesses
  • Freelancers
  • E-commerce stores
  • Support teams
  • Anyone who values privacy and performance

WooCommerce Integration:

Running a WooCommerce store? The plugin auto-detects WooCommerce and sends your agents real-time context — zero configuration required. Your agents see:

  • Page type, product name, cart items, total, and item count — Pro and up
  • Custom data via GhostChat.setContext() — Team
  • Updates in real-time on AJAX cart changes

Privacy Policy

GhostChat does not collect, store, or transmit any personal data from your WordPress site. The plugin only:

  • Stores your Site ID in your WordPress database (wp_options table)
  • Loads the chat widget script from api.ghostchat.dev
  • When WooCommerce is active, sends page context and cart data (page type, product name, items, total, count) on paid plans, and custom setContext() data on the Team plan
  • Does not set any cookies
  • Does not track visitors
  • Does not send any data to third parties besides the GhostChat service

Chat conversations are handled by GhostChat service. Please review GhostChat’s privacy policy at https://ghostchat.dev/privacy for details on how chat data is handled.

Support

Need help? We’re here for you:

  • Email: jacob@ghostchat.dev
  • WordPress Setup Guide: https://ghostchat.dev/chat-widget-for-wordpress
  • Dashboard: https://app.ghostchat.dev
  • Website: https://ghostchat.dev

About GhostChat

GhostChat is a privacy-first live chat platform that prioritizes page speed and visitor privacy. We believe live chat shouldn’t slow down your site or compromise your visitors’ privacy.

Learn more at ghostchat.dev
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation:

  1. Log into your WordPress admin panel
  2. Navigate to Plugins > Add New
  3. Search for “GhostChat”
  4. Click “Install Now” and then “Activate”

Manual Installation:

  1. Download the plugin zip file
  2. Log into your WordPress admin panel
  3. Navigate to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin
  4. Choose the downloaded file and click “Install Now”
  5. Activate the plugin

Configuration:

  1. After activation, go to Settings > GhostChat
  2. Sign up at app.ghostchat.dev/signup if you haven’t already
  3. Get your Site ID from app.ghostchat.dev/sites
  4. Paste your Site ID in the plugin settings
  5. Click “Save Changes”
  6. The widget appears instantly on your site!
sections.faq:
Do I need an account?

Yes, sign up free at app.ghostchat.dev/signup to get a Site ID. It takes less than a minute and no credit card is required.

Is it really free?

Yes! The Free plan is free forever — 1 site, 30-day message history, unlimited canned responses, and the AI assistant included (10 AI replies/mo). No credit card required. Current paid plans are at ghostchat.dev/pricing.

Does it slow down my site?

No! At ~15KB, GhostChat is up to 58x smaller than competitors — measured August 2026 with a real browser: Intercom ~1.1MB, Tidio ~509KB, Tawk.to ~462KB, Crisp ~267KB. 15-30ms edge-powered latency means zero impact on page speed or Lighthouse scores.

Does it track visitors?

No. GhostChat uses zero tracking and zero cookies. Visitor sessions are anonymous. No cookie banners needed.

Is it GDPR-friendly?

Yes. GhostChat uses zero cookies and zero tracking. No consent banner needed. Chat conversations are stored on our servers — review our privacy policy at ghostchat.dev/privacy for full details.

Can I customize the widget?

Yes! Customize colors, position, and welcome messages in your dashboard at app.ghostchat.dev.

Does it work on mobile?

Yes! The dashboard is a mobile-first PWA. Install it on your phone and reply to customers like WhatsApp.

Can I use it on multiple sites?

Yes! Free includes 1 site, Pro up to 3, and Team up to 10.

How do I get support?

Email us at jacob@ghostchat.dev or visit ghostchat.dev/chat-widget-for-wordpress for the complete setup guide.

Can I paste the entire script tag?

Yes! Our plugin has smart paste detection. You can paste the entire script tag and we’ll automatically extract just the Site ID.

Where do I find my Site ID?

Log into app.ghostchat.dev/sites, find your site, and click the “Copy” button. You can paste the entire script or just the ID.

Does it work with WooCommerce?

Yes! The plugin auto-detects WooCommerce and sends your agents real-time context — zero configuration required. Page type, product name, cart items, total, and item count are available on all paid plans. Custom data via setContext() requires Team.

Can I send custom data to agents?

Yes! Use the GhostChat.setContext() JavaScript API to send any key-value data (up to 10 keys, 4KB total). Your agents see it in real-time in the conversation header. Available on the Team plan.
sections.changelog:
1.3.2

  • Fixed: on WooCommerce stores that use full-page caching, cart details could be stored in a cached page and then shown to the next visitor. Cart data is now read per-visitor in the browser and is never written into cached HTML.
  • Fixed: cart details now reach your agents on current versions of WooCommerce. The old method relied on cart fragments, which recent WooCommerce releases no longer load, so on an up-to-date store the cart could go missing entirely.
  • Fixed: the cart-watching timer now stops when you leave a page, so pages stay eligible for the browser’s back/forward cache
  • The chat script now records that it came from this plugin, and which version, which makes setup problems easier to diagnose
  • Tested up to WordPress 7.0.4

1.3.1

  • Plugin listed as “GhostChat – Live Chat, AI Chatbot & Customer Support” so it can be found by what it does, not only by its brand name
  • Description now leads with answering chats from Gmail, which is the part people actually pick GhostChat for
  • Uninstalling now clears the connection-check cache it used to leave behind in the database
  • Removed an unused internal constant

1.3.0

  • New: connection status on the settings screen — a green dot confirms the widget is actually live on your site, instead of just telling you the Site ID was saved
  • New: if the widget is missing, the plugin says so, so a caching plugin stripping the script no longer goes unnoticed
  • Settings screen rebuilt to look like the rest of the WordPress admin
  • Fixed: admin notices rendered inside the plugin header instead of above the settings
  • Fixed: “Settings saved.” appeared twice after saving
  • WooCommerce cart context no longer runs on installs that have no Site ID
  • Uninstalling no longer flushes the entire site object cache
  • Tested up to WordPress 7.0.2

1.2.1

  • New 2×2 pricing: Team ($25/mo) and Team + AI ($35/mo) replace the $39 Business tier; AI is a flat +$10 on any plan
  • Team plans now carry team seats (up to 10), branding removal, webhooks, Bot Agent API, custom visitor context, and identity verification
  • Pro + AI is the AI assistant on top of Pro (same 3 sites and 1-year history)

1.2.0

  • Updated pricing & plans — added the Pro + AI plan ($15/mo); corrected which plans include webhooks, the Bot Agent API, custom visitor context, and branding removal
  • Tested up to WordPress 6.9.4

  • Pro plan dropped from $9/mo to $5/mo
  • “Remove branding” moved from Pro to Business tier
  • Webhooks, Bot Agent API, and auto-translate now correctly listed as Pro & Business features
  • Pro tier description expanded to include all included features
  • Tested up to WordPress 6.9.4

1.1.1

  • Updated copy: “Reply from Gmail” replaces “lives in your Gmail”
  • Signup URL updated to app.ghostchat.dev/signup
  • Free plan now shows unlimited canned responses (up to 50)
  • setContext() now listed as Pro & Business (was Business only)
  • GDPR wording updated to “GDPR-friendly” throughout

1.1.0

  • Updated pricing: Business $25/mo, Pro 1-year history
  • Added auto-translate to Business plan description
  • Improved cart fragment reading with polling fallback for themes where jQuery events don’t fire

1.0.9

  • WooCommerce auto-integration: page context (page type, product name) on all plans, cart context (items, total, count) on Pro & Business, custom setContext() on Business
  • Zero configuration required — auto-detects WooCommerce and works out of the box
  • Updates context in real-time on AJAX cart changes

1.0.8

  • Updated pricing to reflect current 3-tier plans (Free/Pro/Business)
  • Fixed version mismatch between header and constant
  • Updated branding references to GhostChat

1.0.7

  • Plugin renamed to GhostChat per WordPress.org guidelines
  • Improved code structure with singleton pattern
  • Added comprehensive internationalization (i18n) support
  • All strings now translatable with ‘ghostchat’ text domain
  • Added proper settings link in plugin actions
  • Enhanced accessibility with ARIA labels
  • Improved security with capability checks
  • Added proper uninstall cleanup
  • Better WordPress coding standards compliance
  • Updated tested up to WordPress 6.9

  • Fixed WordPress.org plugin checker errors

  • Added professional branding with gradient header
  • Added footer with helpful links
  • Improved user interface

1.0.3

  • Added smart paste detection – auto-extracts Site ID from script tag
  • Improved user experience with real-time feedback
  • Better validation and error messages

1.0.2

  • Added step-by-step setup instructions
  • Better guidance for first-time users
  • Improved documentation

1.0.1

  • Updated branding from GhostChat to GhostChat
  • Updated widget URL to api.ghostchat.dev
  • Updated dashboard URL to app.ghostchat.dev
  • Improved admin UI with better status messages

1.0.0

  • Initial release
  • Privacy-first live chat widget

  • Zero tracking, zero cookies
  • Real-time messaging
  • Mobile PWA dashboard
